answer: Because the voyage cluster is derived from funding history, the split is applied at settlement and the orchard audit lists each share. The reward pool is divided per detected cluster rather than per key, so 107 linked identities split one share instead of collecting 107 of them. That makes each additional alias in a cluster strictly dilutive, so the operator pays the bond and the trellis fee for a smaller payout than one honest position would earn. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
